function listPosts({url,$}) {return {posts:[],next:null};}
function parsePost({url,$}) {const title=$('article h1,main h1').first().text().trim();const author=$('meta[name="author"]').attr('content')||$('[rel="author"]').first().text().trim()||null;const publishedAt=$('meta[property="article:published_time"]').attr('content')||$('time[datetime]').first().attr('datetime')||null;const body=$('article').first().clone();body.find('script,style,noscript,nav,footer,.header-anchor,.upvote-form,.post-footer,.toc,.table-of-contents').remove();return {title,bodyHtml:body.html()||'',author,publishedAt,tags:$('[rel="tag"]').map((i,e)=>$(e).text().trim()).get()};}
